plan_review.notes: Independent plan review identified the canonical lock metadata, docs-only install, and action-required race risks; all were addressed, with the plan remaining convergent.

rounds.notes: Review findings covered tarball provenance, dependency-scope wiring, docs-only setup, and admin-intervention false positives; all were fixed and re-reviewed.

independent_grade.notes: The integrity gate is correctly wired to dependency-scoped CI, fails closed on untrusted or unavailable metadata, validates canonical tarball metadata and quarantine age, and includes focused tests for its core decision logic. Coverage does not exercise workflow/action or incident-recovery integration, and the incident-recovery change broadens scope, but neither yields a high-confidence actionable defect.
